description:
A per-ordinal fact needs the ordinal count where the graph is built, and the type that describes a plan's demand belongs beside the plan.

Today DispatchMatrixBuilder::build (src/dispatch_matrix/mod.rs ~826-832) drops input_count; PatternDispatchPlan re-carries its own copy. DispatchDemand and join_assign (src/compiler2/keying.rs:17-45) depend on nothing but BTreeMap; dispatch_matrix has no compiler2 dependency, so the move creates no cycle.

Change: DispatchMatrix keeps input_count; the plan reads it from the matrix. DispatchDemand, demand_for_region, the subject path fold and demand_at_path (jobs/keying.rs ~1120-1184) move into dispatch_matrix as plan-level helpers. Users in compiler2/types/mod.rs, world.rs, jobs/keying.rs and their tests re-import.

Signal: byte-identical behaviour. The six-target gate and the canon double-compile equality tests prove it. No new concept; one relocation.
title: The dispatch matrix carries input_count; DispatchDemand moves into dispatch_matrix
